title: A double-pointed wooden throwing stick from Schöningen, Germany: Results and new insights from a multianalytical study
lineage: Full original publisher HTML retained. The paper dates the horizon around 300 ka; a later 2025 study proposes approximately 200 ka. Function as a hand-thrown stick is an interpretation with alternatives.

passages.note: Abstract; Introduction; Discussion 4.2–4.3: tool morphology, hypotheses of throwing and alternatives.
